message: In our fast-paced world, it's easy to forget about the simple joys of being prepared for a family road trip. I came across a great resource that reminds us how to keep our cars ready for anything—without relying too much on tech! It's a refreshing way to rediscover low-tech fun, like packing snacks and playing classic road games. What’s your favorite way to prepare for a journey with the family? 🚗
